title: Conditional kappa = 0.001677160151714381 via capped phase-cell fusion
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This contribution replaces the repeated-axis outer Gaussian resampling cost by a capped, in-place tensor construction. With the unchanged pinned T74 supplier from #1661, the resulting **final** conditional bound is

$$T(n)=O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}),\qquad \kappa=1677160151714381/10^{18}=0.001677160151714381.$$

The new outer argument combines shallow reversible Toeplitz circuits, a common Hadamard schedule, recentered/capped Gaussian interiors, and paid sparse boundary and routing operations. It improves the same supplier's #1661 outer result by approximately `2.6348269308e-7` in kappa. This is a proof/construction contribution with finite supporting checks, not merely a finer numerical grid or a new primitive supplier.

The package retains the original all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source, whole-call hosting, semantic precision (`C1=1`), fixed-tape/prime-packing, paid interchange, exact recovery and analytic assumptions. It does not claim an unconditional or fully formalized multiplication theorem. A separate supplementary `0.001677600129305161` corollary explicitly assumes `omega_C <= 9/4`; that premise is **not needed for the headline result**.

Review entry point: [package README](https://github.com/Vlado-V/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2569871ff906d2a2abfc86e97126ab9afe2e4a5a/research/capped-phase-fusion/README.md), [complete proof](https://github.com/Vlado-V/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2569871ff906d2a2abfc86e97126ab9afe2e4a5a/research/capped-phase-fusion/phase_fusion_note.tex), and [supplier substitution review](https://github.com/Vlado-V/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2569871ff906d2a2abfc86e97126ab9afe2e4a5a/research/capped-phase-fusion/frontier_fusion/INDEPENDENT-SUBSTITUTION-REVIEW.md). The selected frontier is not modified.

## Task and overlap

- Explicit user assignment: strengthen the bound using broad mathematical resources, then publish this verified result. Indexed under `uniform-transfer-audit`, with **changed scope** from one implication audit to a replacement outer transfer; see `TASK.json`.
- Publication base: `a5d4f08ac102d1a6da301d89379c75285eca680e`; original research snapshot: `e6f9716621f4e01fc190617934cdfaf072bd976f`.
- Exact supplier dependency: #1661 at `f852af5e178ce035cd46181a29d9330bcbcaa206`, source manifest SHA256 `d90d49eaa68e48c6992a07972e736ef4b9cd80274361cbbc1ec980d43f29ad7f`.
- #489 already develops a branch-free Gaussian inverse; this contribution supplies a different in-place tensor compiler, capped gauges, and boundary/layout transfer. #1141's reversible phase stream is related background, not a dependency. #1661 supplies the unchanged finite construction. No global priority or optimality claim is made.
- Refreshed `find_overlap.py --task uniform-transfer-audit` and checked current PR/discussion material before publication; search coverage is not a novelty certificate.

## Validation

From repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -m pip install sympy==1.14.0
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/capped-phase-fusion
```

This registered replay **passed locally with Python 3.12.15 and SymPy 1.14.0**. It recreates and compares 21 exact algebra, tensor, Gaussian, layout, moment and outer-ledger receipts in a temporary copy. The headline ledger has 45 strictly positive exact inequalities and five rejecting variants. Additional publication controls reject an inert checker leaving stale evidence and altered native semantics.

The complete unmodified #1661 native replay also **passed afresh**, with no native reuse: 12 top-level stages, both new provider words, retained parent, 319680 owners, prefix 1441 charged at 2048, and row coefficient 19545 below 20161. Rejected controls: 114 admission, 12 bit, 15 controller, eight independent owner, six geometry. The portable binder checks all 58 receipt files and 46 canonical JSON receipt hashes. Python 3.14.7, NumPy 2.5.4, SciPy 1.18.1 and SymPy 1.14.0 were used for that local run; C++17 and Boost are needed for the native pipeline.

`PUBLICATION-CHECKS.json` records the exact evidence; the README gives the full pinned cold command. The 121 MB native assembly and vendor tree are reproduced externally rather than duplicated. Historical receipts/manifests are labeled; `PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json` is authoritative. Hosted CI, independent human review, and all-size proof-assistant verification are not claimed as completed.

## Authorship and sources

Prepared by Vlado Vojdanovski with substantial AI assistance. Source references and original notices are included in the package. New material is Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

The [package's next questions](https://github.com/Vlado-V/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2569871ff906d2a2abfc86e97126ab9afe2e4a5a/research/capped-phase-fusion/README.md#open-next-questions) identify concrete follow-ups: a stronger fully costed finite supplier, independent reconstruction/formalization of the new tape/layout lemmas, and source-bound substitution of future suppliers. The present complex endpoint still prevents this construction from reaching final kappa `0.002`.
